summary: GI round 4, package PI (the inventory), declared BEFORE any code: three reading changes in studio/gi/services.py, one parameter in validation/checks.required_fact_states and one argument in validation/engine._proposal. (1) The instrument as the subject of its own reach ('The colonoscope reached the cecum') states its service performed in the inventory - only where the document carries a procedure report's own head (sections.procedure_report_head), its head is no note written around a procedure (sections.around_procedure_title), the instrument is not under another occurrence (sections.under_another_occurrence), its clause carries no date and the inventory's reading is otherwise silent. Implemented as a guarded promotion in _build's instrument pass with new _pi_ helpers; the module-wide ACT_VERB is NOT widened, because a regex cannot carry the head guard and the unguarded form (the minimal design's tree_c) reads the copied 'The colonoscope reached the cecum' of a records review as performed (judge rows J1-J3, H3 records documents). (2) Paragraph carry (A1): with more than one family performed, an act or lesion no part, name or site gives a family takes the family its paragraph last named - same part, never a history, plan or indication part, never a field or box row, within CARRY_REACH characters with no blank line between, the carried family itself performed, every region the clause or sentence names one that family reaches, and a sentence naming two families clears the carry. (3) E1: where routing reads no extent and does not read the family as done today, a performed service the inventory reads complete by its own endpoint statement takes the deepest endpoint landmark those statements name (routing's labels; EGD and colonoscopy only), never from a statement in a history or plan section (layout of the text the inventory reads and of the original), under another occurrence, carrying an extent word, or after an extent label; checks.required_fact_states uses that extent only when routing has no extent fact and does not read the family positive; engine._proposal passes the matched service. (4) The hold-only W1 guard: an indwelling stent's state ('The existing stent was in position and draining.') is not a performed act - applied only where the same service documents another stent performed (a new stent placed beside it still counts), so removing the phantom can never release a base-included hold or an unresolved item. NOTE, declared now: this guard does NOT hold h2-10's 43274 - 43274 covers the new stent placed across the stricture, which stays performed; the plan's 'so h2-10's 43274 is held' does not follow from the guard as specified (holding it needs the stent exchange read as its own act, the W1 vocabulary the plan parks for a coder or the owner).

rules.strong_head: S1 and E1 read only where the document is today's procedure report by a STRONG head (detect.todays_procedure_report, read on the text as written): among the head's first 12 non-empty lines, each as a labelled field at the start of its line - an own-date field (a label the date reader itself reads as the service date, installed or wide: context.SERVICE_DATE or context.WIDE_SERVICE_DATE, with a calendar date as its value), a proceduralist field (proceduralist, endoscopist, operator, performing physician or endoscopist, gastroenterologist, colonoscopist: sections.PROCEDURE_HEAD's field names without 'attending') and a sedation field (a label naming sedation, a sedative, anesthesia or an anesthetic, propofol, midazolam, fentanyl, MAC or a CRNA, whose value is no denial such as 'none' or 'not applicable'); the own-date fields name one day only; and no title line of the head names a later review, a result, an addendum or another record. It REPLACES sections.procedure_report_head in _pi_own_report (the binding rule: not PS's loose word match); sections.around_procedure_title and routing's office-visit check stay.
rules.todays_narrative: S1's reach and E1's completion statement count only inside today's procedure narrative (detect.in_todays_narrative, read on the text as written; one implementation shared with package PE's routing-only reach): (1) no foreign block opens before the passage - a heading-like line naming an attachment or a copy (attached, scanned, enclosed, copied, pasted, imported, forwarded, faxed, appended, excerpt, quoted, transcribed, reproduced, uploaded, an outside or external report or record) or carrying a date other than today's, a sign-off line (signed, attested, authenticated, co-signed, dictated, finalized or verified, with a name, a colon or a date), or a statement that a copy follows ('copied below', 'is attached', 'see attached', 'a copy of the report'), after the head's own fields; (2) its governing heading-like line, the nearest short stand-alone line above it, looked up within 200 lines and 20,000 characters (beyond that: no release), names no other record or occasion (sections.ANOTHER_OCCURRENCE_HEAD, the attachment words above, education or instructions), no facility when it stands below the head's own fields, carries no date other than today's, and is no history, plan or indication heading of the layout; (3) its block (between blank lines or heading-like lines, at most 2,000 characters each side) carries no date other than today's and no sign-off line; (4) its own sentence states no unit statistics or generalisation ('in 98 of 100 patients', 'in our unit', a percentage, 'most patients', 'usually'); (5) it is not under another occurrence (sections.under_another_occurrence, now read here once for S1, E1 and PE, instead of in each caller); (6) it is not beyond heading reach (sections.beyond_heading_reach). 'Today' is the head's one own date, else the effective service date, else none (then every date holds).
rules.s1_family_named: S1 is never read for a family the head excludes: where a title line of the head or a head procedure field ('Procedure:', 'Procedures performed:', 'Operation:', 'Examination:') names procedures by the inventory's own SERVICES names and none of them is the instrument's family ('Procedure: EGD with biopsy.' above an attached colonoscopy), the reach stays silent. A head that names no procedure by those names adds no hold.
rules.a1_lesion_carry: A1: a paragraph carry yields no family - the act or lesion stays unattributed, as installed - where the paragraph's last lesion given a family (the lesion carry: same part, within CARRY_REACH characters, no blank line between) belongs to another family than the carry. A sentence that names one service never re-binds an act whose lesion carry is another service's: a misbinding holds, it never binds to the wrong service.
